text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. You lot are always on about 
loyalty this, duty that—truly serious to a 
fault, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Devoting one's loyalty to the 
one chosen as master is the highest honor 
for a knight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
My being here... is thanks to a debt of 
gratitude. Repaying it... is my duty.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. But from where I'm standing, it's 
dreadfully boring!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have any burning ambition?! Yes, 
where is your spirit to overthrow the 
top?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!? There's no way something like that 
could exist, right!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—It is possible—at any time. Though right 
now—I have no desire—to do so.”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? S-Someone like Kris S-san would do 
something like that!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so you were hiding such true feelings 
behind that straight face! Fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Buuut... feeeel sooorry... for the... 
fffrrrooooggg...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Geko" is――in Japan――the sound a frog 
makes. So――does that mean――this isn't―― 
about exterminating frogs?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Look here, you. What I meant was— ...Well, 
never mind.
